title: 第214章 群英赴渊破迷障魔源现世撼诸天第213章 父女同心诛诡谍渊封欲碎起狂澜
content_zh:
第214章群英赴渊破迷障，魔源现世撼诸天
“不好！刚才的冲击扰动祭坛阵法，提前唤醒了魔渊本源！”墨衍脸色剧变。
深渊深处，无边无际的黑影缓缓上浮，磅礴威压笼罩整片荒原，天地间光线迅速暗淡，狂风裹挟碎石疯狂席卷四方。
远处所有将士浑身僵直，修为弱小者双腿止不住发抖，本能升起深入骨髓的恐惧。
暗谍趴在祭坛上，疯狂大笑起来：“哈哈哈！天意！封印提前松动，魔渊本源出世！”
“即便我今日败在你们手中，你们也无力阻拦浩劫降临！等到本源冲出深渊，整个五域都会沦为炼狱！”
他强忍伤势，想要趁机遁走，寻机坐观残局。
“想逃？做梦！留下吧！”妲己身形瞬间封堵退路，粉色妖气牢牢锁住暗谍周身空间。
西施操控万千水丝缠绕他四肢，将人死死钉在祭坛石面上，杜绝逃跑可能。
此刻没有人再分心看管暗谍，所有人的目光，全部投向下方不断扩张的断魂渊。
蔡文姬快步走到祭坛边缘，向下眺望无底深渊。
鲲形玉坠在腰间滚烫灼烧，体内清音血脉激烈共鸣，脑海不断回响玉册留下的箴言。
墨衍站在她身侧，语气沉重：“计划被打乱，本源提前苏醒，想要重铸封印，必须踏入渊底核心。”
“但渊内魔气足以侵蚀金丹修士神魂，危险万分。”
蔡文姬轻轻触摸胡笳琴弦虚影，内心已然下定决断。
“既然没有别的选择！”
她转头看向身边并肩作战的众人：“我需要进入断魂渊核心稳固封印！嫦娥、大乔、西施、妲己，随我一同下渊。”
“伽罗、黄忠、铠、韩信，统领联军守住荒原祭坛，看管暗谍，阻挡魔军干扰。”
杨玉环上前一步：“副帅，我与你同行，双琴清音合力，净化之力更强。”
墨衍沉声道：“姬儿，我也一同入渊，我身负同源血脉，可以帮你抵挡一部分本源侵蚀。”

安排迅速敲定。
铠抱拳领命：“副帅放心！只要我们还在，绝不让任何人冲上祭坛干扰封印仪式。”
嫦娥将玉兔抱紧，月华光芒稳稳铺开：“渊底魔气深重，有月华相伴，可保众人不至于被魔元快速侵染。”
梦奇跳到蔡文姬肩头，叽叽喳喳叫唤，主动表示一同深入深渊，吞噬渊底狂暴怨息。
深渊之中，咆哮声越来越近，那股足以覆灭一切的恐怖气息正在持续攀升。
留给众人准备的时间，已经所剩无几。
蔡文姬抬眼望向漆黑无底的断魂渊，深吸一口气。
漫长西征跨越万水千山，闯过东海、中洲、南沼无数险关，所有路途的终点，就在这深渊之下。
“准备妥当，即刻入渊！”
黑石祭坛边缘狂风怒啸，自断魂渊升腾的黑色浓雾滚滚上涌，冰冷刺骨的寒意裹挟蚀骨魔气扑面而来！
哪怕金丹修士，触碰到雾气边缘，灵力运转都会瞬间滞涩。
蔡文姬握紧腰间滚烫的鲲形玉坠，胡笳琴虚影悬浮身前，金色清音层层铺开，在周身构筑一圈防护屏障。

content_en:
Chapter 214: A group of heroes went to the abyss to break the barrier, and the source of evil appeared to shake the heavens
"No! The impact just now disturbed the altar formation and awakened the origin of the Demonic Abyss in advance!" Mo Yan's expression changed drastically.
In the depths of the abyss, the boundless black shadow slowly rose up, and the majestic pressure enveloped the entire wasteland. The light between the sky and the earth dimmed rapidly, and the strong wind swept the gravel crazily in all directions.
All the soldiers in the distance were stiff, and the legs of the weak ones couldn't stop shaking, instinctively raising fear that penetrated their bones.
The secret spy lay on the altar and laughed crazily: "Hahaha! God's will! The seal was loosened in advance, and the origin of the Demonic Abyss was born!"
"Even if I are defeated in your hands today, you will be unable to stop the catastrophe! When the source breaks out of the abyss, the entire five domains will become purgatory!"
He endured his injuries and wanted to take the opportunity to escape, looking for an opportunity to sit back and watch the outcome.
"Want to escape? Dream! Stay!" Daji's figure instantly blocked the escape route, and the pink demonic aura firmly locked the space around the spy.
Xi Shi controlled thousands of water threads to wrap around his limbs, nailing the person to the stone surface of the altar to eliminate the possibility of escape.
At this moment, no one was distracted from watching over the secret spy, and everyone's eyes were focused on the ever-expanding Soul-Dead Abyss below.
Cai Wenji quickly walked to the edge of the altar and looked down into the bottomless abyss.
The Kun-shaped jade pendant is hot and burning on the waist, the voiceless blood in the body resonates fiercely, and the motto left in the jade book is constantly echoing in the mind.
Mo Yan stood beside her and said in a serious tone: "The plan was disrupted and the origin awakened early. If you want to recast the seal, you must step into the core of the abyss."
"But the demonic energy in the abyss is enough to corrode the soul of the Golden elixir monk, which is extremely dangerous."
Cai Wenji gently touched the phantom of the Hujia strings, and she had already made up her mind.
"Since there is no other choice!"
She turned to look at the people fighting side by side: "I need to enter the core of the Duanhun Abyss to stabilize the seal! Chang'e, Da Qiao, Xi Shi, and Daji, follow me into the abyss."
"Jia Luo, Huang Zhong, Kai, and Han Xin will lead the coalition forces to guard the wilderness altar, guard the secret spies, and prevent the demonic army from interfering."
Yang Yuhuan took a step forward: "Deputy Commander, I am walking with you. The combined power of the two pianos to purify is stronger."
Mo Yan said in a deep voice: "Ji'er, I am also entering the abyss. I have the same bloodline and can help you resist some of the erosion of your origin."
Arrangements were quickly finalized.
Kai cupped his fists and accepted the order: "Don't worry, Deputy Commander! As long as we are still here, we will never let anyone rush to the altar to interfere with the sealing ceremony."
Chang'e hugged the Jade Rabbit tightly, and the light of the moonlight spread out steadily: "The demonic energy is deep in the abyss, and the moonlight can protect everyone from being quickly infected by the demonic energy."
Meng Qi jumped on Cai Wenji's shoulder, chirping, and offered to go deep into the abyss together to swallow the violent resentment at the bottom.
In the abyss, the roar is getting closer and closer, and the terrifying aura that can destroy everything is continuing to rise.
There was not much time left for everyone to prepare.
Cai Wenji raised her eyes to look at the dark and bottomless Soul-Dead Abyss and took a deep breath.
The long western expedition spanned thousands of rivers and mountains, and passed through countless dangerous passes in the East China Sea, Central Continent, and South Marsh. The end of all the journeys was under this abyss.
"Get ready, enter the abyss immediately!"
The wind roared furiously at the edge of the black stone altar, the thick black fog rising from the Soul-Desolating Abyss rolled up, and the bone-chilling chill rushed towards my face with the bone-corroding demonic energy!
Even if the golden elixir monk touches the edge of the mist, the movement of his spiritual power will be instantly stagnant.
Cai Wenji grasped the hot Kun-shaped jade pendant around her waist. The phantom of Hu Jia Qin floated in front of her, and the golden clear sound spread out layer by layer, building a protective barrier around her body.
